subject.title: [Bug]: restart storm from telegram.retry.jitter type mismatch + misleading doctor SecretRef for Telegram token

question: After the linked retry-jitter migration is resolved, should this umbrella issue stay open for SecretRef/CDP/multi-runtime hardening, or should the remaining work be split into narrower follow-ups?
rationale: The source-reproducible jitter branch has an open fix candidate, while the other requested fixes cross doctor UX, security follow-up, browser service isolation, and supervisor policy boundaries.

options.title: Land and split scope
options.body: Use the linked PR for the boolean jitter migration and move SecretRef/CDP/multi-runtime work into separate focused issues with concrete reproduction and ownership.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker for the full cascade, accepting that it needs manual scoping before more automation starts.

options.title: Close after jitter only
options.body: Treat the jitter migration as the only actionable repo bug here and request fresh reports if SecretRef or CDP behavior still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Land and split scope
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR for the boolean jitter migration and move SecretRef/CDP/multi-runtime work into separate focused issues with concrete reproduction and ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible repository member already involved in the security-sensitive part of this issue discussion.
